env-runtime:title: Env Runtime
env-runtime:subtitle: Inject vault secrets into approved local commands without exposing values to agents.
env-runtime:secretsDescription: Values stay encrypted in the vault. Agents can discover labels, never values.
env-runtime:secretValueKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value.
env-runtime:secretMasterPasswordHint: Required every time. The value hides after 30 seconds, blur, navigation, or vault lock.
env-runtime:secretsEmptyDescription: Create a secret, then bind it to a named variable in a profile.
env-runtime:secretDeleteMessage: “${label}” will be removed permanently. Secrets used by profiles cannot be deleted.
env-runtime:profilesDescription: Profiles map variable names to vault secrets and sync with the vault.
env-runtime:profileDescriptionPlaceholde: Where and why this environment is used
env-runtime:profilesEmptyDescription: Create a portable mapping from environment variable names to vault secrets.
env-runtime:profileDeleteMessage: “${label}” will be removed. Device presets linked to it may need repair.
env-runtime:presetsDescription: Exact executable, working directory, argv, and passthrough metadata for this Mac.
env-runtime:presetArgsHint: One exact argv item per line. No shell parsing is used.
env-runtime:presetPassthroughHint: One variable name per line. Only explicitly listed parent variables pass through.
env-runtime:presetNoProfiles: Create a profile before saving a device preset.
env-runtime:deviceStoreKeyUnavailable: The macOS Keychain key for device presets is unavailable (${code}). Preset changes and new runs are disabled; secrets, profiles, status, rejection, and stopping active runs remain available.
env-runtime:deviceStoreUnreadable: The encrypted device preset store cannot be read safely (${code}). Preset changes and new runs are disabled; secrets, profiles, status, rejection, and stopping active runs remain available.
env-runtime:deviceStoreUnavailable: Device presets are unavailable (${code}). Preset changes and new runs are disabled; secrets, profiles, status, rejection, and stopping active runs remain available.
env-runtime:presetsEmptyDescription: Save an exact command boundary before an agent can request a run.
env-runtime:presetDeleteMessage: “${label}” will no longer be available for approved runs.
env-runtime:approvalsDescription: Each request is one-time. Review the actor, exact command, paths, and secret labels.
env-runtime:approvalsEmptyDescription: New CLI run requests appear here and expire automatically.
env-runtime:proposalsDescription: Agents can propose metadata changes; only you can apply or reject them.
env-runtime:proposalsEmptyDescription: Profile and preset proposals from paired CLI agents appear here.
env-runtime:proposalReviewDescription: Compare the saved resource with the exact agent proposal before deciding.
env-runtime:proposalBindingHint: Bind every proposed variable to an existing secret before approval.
env-runtime:proposalDeleteDescription: Approving removes this ${resource}; no replacement data is written.
env-runtime:proposalNoCurrentResource: No current saved resource is available.
env-runtime:proposalMissingDraft: The proposal has no draft to review.
env-runtime:proposalUnknownResource: This proposal uses an unsupported resource kind and cannot be reviewed.
env-runtime:proposalHashAfterApproval: Recomputed by Tauri during approval; the saved preset pins the resulting SHA-256.
env-runtime:runsDescription: Active and recent process metadata. Output and secret values are never stored here.
env-runtime:runsEmptyTitle: No runs in this app session
env-runtime:runsEmptyDescription: Approved runs appear here until ChromVoid exits.
env-runtime:runReviewDescription: This one-time request is bound to the exact facts shown below.
env-runtime:runPassthroughOverride: Profile value overrides the passthrough value.
env-runtime:runPlaintextWarning: Approved processes and all descendants receive plaintext environment values. They can read, print, persist, or exfiltrate those secrets. Locking the vault or revoking the agent cannot erase values already passed to the process.
env-runtime:cliDescription: Install the shipped CLI, pair each local identity separately, and revoke identities here.
env-runtime:cliPathHint: If chromvoid is not found, add ~/.local/bin to PATH. ChromVoid never edits shell profiles.
env-runtime:cliInstallConflict: ChromVoid will never replace an unmanaged file at the install path.
env-runtime:cliPairInstruction: In a local interactive terminal, run:
env-runtime:cliPairSecurity: Enter this code only in the local terminal prompt. Never put it in command arguments or chat.
env-runtime:cliRevokeMessage: “${label}” will lose access and its active runs will be stopped.
env-runtime:accessUnsupportedTitle: Env Runtime is unavailable on this device
env-runtime:accessUnsupportedDescription: Vault Env Runtime v1 is available in the macOS desktop app.
env-runtime:accessRemoteCoreTitle: Env Runtime requires a local vault
env-runtime:accessRemoteCoreDescription: Switch ChromVoid from remote Core to local Core before managing secrets or approving local commands.
env-runtime:accessLockedDescription: Enable a Pro license to manage secrets, profiles, presets, and approved local runs.
env-runtime:accessUnavailableDescription: ChromVoid could not confirm the module entitlement. Refresh license status and try again.
env-runtime:reviewClosed: Review closed because the request is no longer resolvable (${code}).
env-runtime:errorLabelTooLong: Use no more than 80 UTF-8 bytes.
env-runtime:errorSecretValueTooLong: Use no more than 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.
env-runtime:errorSlugFormat: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores; start and end with a letter or digit.
env-runtime:errorDescriptionTooLong: Use no more than 512 UTF-8 bytes.
env-runtime:errorVariableRequired: Add at least one variable mapping.
env-runtime:errorVariableName: Use a valid environment variable name.
env-runtime:errorArgLength: Each argument must be no more than 4 KiB and all arguments together no more than 64 KiB.
env-runtime:errorPassthroughCount: Use no more than 32 passthrough variables.
